$comment: 听力训练营 L22（P-L3 续跑，阶段三第二课）。脚本 100% 原创；Part 3 观点直说（一段长对话 5 题：为什么不去电影院 / 觉得动物园怎么样 / 对去海滩什么感受 / 为什么坐公交 / 觉得海滩咖啡馆怎么样）+ Part 5 匹配直给（Tom 告诉妈妈五个朋友周末各去哪里，8 个地点 A-H 全部被提到，3 个是干扰）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 1.0x。
title: Where to Go at the Weekend
intro: 先听 Tom 和 Kate 商量周六去哪里玩：电影院、动物园还是海滩？题目问的是「为什么不去」「觉得怎么样」「什么感受」，每个地方都会被说到好处和坏处，要抓住说话人自己最后的态度。再听 Tom 告诉妈妈五个朋友周末各去哪里，把人和地点配起来——8 个地点都会被提到，有 3 个没人去。

sections.intro: 听 Tom 和 Kate 商量周六去哪里玩。五道题问的是理由和看法，注意「but」后面的话，那才是说话人真正的意思。

script.text: Hi Kate. Are you free on Saturday? There's a new film at the cinema, and the tickets are cheaper on Saturday mornings.
I saw that film last week with my cousin. It was good, but I don't want to see it again. The cinema is a long way from my house, but that isn't a problem.
OK. Then what about the zoo? It's only ten minutes on the bus.
I know it's near, but I went last year and I found it really boring. You walk for hours and the animals are all asleep. The tickets cost a lot as well, but that's not the real problem.
All right. Let's go to the beach, then. My dad can drive us to the bus station.
The beach! Yes! I'd love that. I haven't been there for months.
The beach in October? It might rain. And aren't you tired after your football match on Friday?
I looked at the weather on my phone. It's going to be sunny all day, so I'm not worried. And I'll be fine after a good sleep. Shall we take the train? It's faster.
It's faster, but it stops in the town centre, and then it's a long walk to the beach. The bus stops right next to the beach. The tickets cost about the same, so let's take the bus.
Good idea. And we can have lunch at the café by the beach.
My dad says that café is too expensive.
It isn't, if you just have a sandwich and a drink. I went there in the summer and the food was great. It gets noisy when it's busy, but we can eat early.
OK. Let's meet at the bus stop at nine. Don't forget your hat!

questions.q: Why doesn't Kate want to go to the cinema?
options: She has already seen the film.
It is a long way from her house.
questions.explain: I saw that film last week… I don't want to see it again——她已经看过了。「票价」是 Tom 说周六早上更便宜；「离家远」她自己说了 but that isn't a problem，不是原因。

questions.q: What does Kate think about the zoo?
questions.explain: I went last year and I found it really boring——她自己的看法是无聊。「远」不对，Tom 说只要十分钟；「贵」她提到了，但说 that's not the real problem。

questions.q: How does Kate feel about going to the beach?
options: She is worried about the weather.
She is too tired to go.
questions.explain: The beach! Yes! I'd love that——很兴奋。「担心天气」是 Tom 说可能下雨，Kate 查了天气说 I'm not worried；「累」也是 Tom 问的，她说睡一觉就好。

questions.q: Why does Tom want to take the bus?
options: It is faster than the train.
It stops next to the beach.
It is cheaper than the train.
questions.explain: The bus stops right next to the beach——坐火车下车还要走很远。「更快」的是火车；票价 about the same，不是更便宜。

questions.q: What does Kate think about the café by the beach?
questions.explain: I went there in the summer and the food was great——她自己的评价是好吃。「太贵」是 Tom 爸爸说的，Kate 说只点三明治不贵；「吵」她提到了，但说可以早点吃，不是问题。

sections.intro: 听 Tom 告诉妈妈五个朋友这个周末各去哪里。把每个人和右边 A-H 的地点配起来。8 个地点都会被提到，有 3 个没人去——注意听「最后去的是哪里」。

script.text: So you and Kate are going to the beach on Saturday. Are your other friends doing anything this weekend?
Yes, everyone's busy. Lily is going to the museum with her dad. There's a new room with old ships, and she loves that kind of thing.
That sounds nice. Isn't she going to the cinema with you? She usually does.
Not this time. And Max is going to his uncle's farm. He's going to help with the horses all weekend.
Max on a farm! He'll come home very dirty. What about Olivia?
Olivia is going to the market with her mum on Sunday morning. Her mum sells fruit there, and Olivia helps her.
She's a good girl. And Harry? Is he going to the zoo again? He goes every month.
No, the zoo is closed this weekend. Harry is going to the park to play football with his brother.
And Sophie? Let me guess. She's staying at home with a book.
Nearly. She's going to the library. They have a story-writing morning on Saturday, and she really wants to go.
Well, everyone has a plan. Now go and find your beach hat.

questions.explain: Lily is going to the museum with her dad——直接说了。妈妈问是不是去电影院，Tom 说 Not this time。
Max is going to his uncle's farm——去叔叔的农场帮忙照看马。
Olivia is going to the market with her mum——周日早上去集市帮妈妈卖水果。
Is he going to the zoo again? No, the zoo is closed… Harry is going to the park——动物园是干扰（关门了），最后去的是公园。
She's going to the library——妈妈猜她在家看书，Tom 说 Nearly（差不多），其实是去图书馆参加写故事活动。
